text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Germany reported to be ready to increase cooperation with Tunisia in the environment sector.
- Agriculture Minister Mabrouk Bahri wants to achieve self-sufficiency in foodstuff production.
- Qatar Crown Prince Sheikh Jassim bin Hamad on Sunday visited the northern city of Bizerte. He was expected to end on Monday a three-day official visit to Tunisia.
